attempts.notes: Two fixes: (1) Yul's `if` statement has no `else` clause, which caused the 'Call or assignment expected' error at the `} else {` on line 50 — restructured so the long-data layout loads are the default and the short-data case overwrites them inside a plain `if`. (2) `!(0x1f & length)` applied Solidity's boolean `!` to a `uint256`; replaced with the explicit comparison `(0x1f & length) == 0`.

The two errors were caused by the bare literal 0x20 inside abi.encodePacked, which Solidity cannot packed-encode without a concrete type. Casted it to uint256 (matching the 32-byte ABI offset word the decompiled logic reconstruct). No other changes were needed; all functions, names, and signatures are preserved.

The assembly `if` statement in Yul does not support an `else` branch, which caused the parse error at the `} else {`. Replaced it with a `switch` on `and(packed, 0x01)` with `case 0x01` / `default` branches preserving the original logic. Also moved the mask computation out of the return expression into a plain typed `uint256 mask` assignment, and replaced the invalid `!(uint)` boolean negation with an explicit `== 0` comparison, since Solidity's `!` operator only accepts `bool`.
